ReviewOutcomes.Scheduled: Scheduled for the selected review time.
ReviewOutcomes.Dispatched: The review is being processed. You will be notified when it finishes.
ReviewOutcomes.Pending: Awaiting eligibility checks. Temporary service or network problems are retried automatically.
ReviewOutcomes.Requested: Eligibility checks passed. The financial operation is still processing.
ReviewOutcomes.Completed: The financial operation completed. Open the original transaction to view its details.
ReviewOutcomes.Failed: The requested operation did not complete. Open the original transaction to check its financial outcome.
ReviewOutcomes.Ineligible: The original transaction is not eligible for this operation. Open the transaction to check its status and previous refunds.
ReviewOutcomes.original_ineligible: The original transaction is not a completed payment eligible for this operation.
ReviewOutcomes.already_refunded: The original payment has already been refunded. A second refund is not allowed.
ReviewOutcomes.refund_exceeds_original: This refund would exceed the remaining refundable amount.
ReviewOutcomes.insufficient_funds: The source account has insufficient available funds for this operation.
ReviewOutcomes.transaction_requested: Eligibility checks passed. The financial operation is still processing.
ReviewOutcomes.Default: The review has updated. Open the original transaction for details.
ReviewOutcomes.refund_exists: The original payment has already been refunded. A second refund is not allowed.
ReviewOutcomes.reversal_exists: A refund or recall already exists for this transaction. A duplicate operation is not allowed.
ReviewOutcomes.service_unavailable: A required service was unavailable. Open the transaction to check the current outcome before starting another review.
ReviewOutcomes.refund_ineligible: Only an eligible original debit can be refunded. Check the transaction status and previous refunds.
ReviewOutcomes.recall_ineligible: Only a posted refund can be recalled. Check the original refund status.
